items.description: LIC of India came into being with its Central Office at Mumbai.
Promulgation of ordinance for the nationalization of life insurance business in India.
Notification of establishment of Insurance Ombudsman.
Supreme Court judgment relating to HLV (Human Life Value) of a person. (⚠️ exact case name/citation not independently verifiable — confirm from your study material before quoting in exam)

items.title: April 2000
items.description: IRDA got statutory body status for Life, Non-Life, and Health Insurance Industry.

items.title: November 2010
items.description: As per IRDA Circular, all Universal Life products to be known as Variable Insurance Products (VIP).

items.title: 30 Days
items.description: Free Look-in Period (latest IRDAI guidelines — increased from 15 to 30 days in 2024).

items.title: 15 Days
items.description: Underwriter to decide on a proposal within.

items.title: 10 Days
items.description: Insurer to respond to a policyholder communique/query within.

items.title: 30 Days
items.description: Insurers to pay/dispute a valid claim within (general rule, post Protection of Policyholders' Interests Regulations). Latest update: IRDAI Master Circular (Sept 2024) sets — Death claims without investigation: 15 days | Death claims with investigation: 45 days.

items.title: 15 Days
items.description: Complainant to accept the recommendation of the Ombudsman.

items.title: 30 Days
items.description: Insurers to honor and implement the Ombudsman award within.

items.title: 90 Days
items.description: Ombudsman to decide a complaint and pass an award within (3 months).

items.title: 90 Days
items.description: Insurer to complete claim investigation within (older 2002 Regulations figure. Latest 2024 Master Circular reduces this to 45 days for life insurance death claims requiring investigation).

items.title: 30 Days
items.description: Interest payable to claimant if Ombudsman award not implemented within this period.

items.title: 7 Years
items.description: An insured is presumed dead.

items.title: 1 Year
items.description: Complaint can be filed with Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year of claim rejection.

items.title: 2 Years
items.description: Complaint can be filed with Consumer Forum within 2 years from cause of action.
Indian Contract Act was passed.
Indian Evidence Act was passed.
Married Women's Property (MWP) Act was passed.
Transfer of Property Act was passed.
Life Insurance Companies Act was passed.
Workman Compensation Act was passed (now Employees Compensation Act).
Insurance Act was passed.
Employees State Insurance (ESI) Act was passed.
Employees Provident Fund and Misc Provisions Act was passed.
LIC of India Act was passed.
Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) Act was passed.
Marine Insurance Act was passed.
Export Credit Guarantee Corporation (ECGC) renamed and reorganized.
General Insurance Business (Nationalization) Act (GIBNA) was passed.
Universal Life Policy introduced in the USA.
Consumer Protection Act (originally passed).
Motor Vehicles Act was passed.
First pre-funded health insurance plan 'Bhavishya Arogya' marketed by 4 PSU general insurers.
Public Liability Insurance Act was passed.
Malhotra Committee set up.
Insurance Regulatory Authority (IRA) established.
IRDA Act passed.
Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) enacted.
General Insurance Business (Nationalization) Amendment Act was passed.
PMLA 2002 implemented.

IRDA renamed IRDAI (via Insurance Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 26-12-2014; formally enacted as Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015 — some sources cite 2015/2016, so cross-check with your study source if exam-specific).
